messages.subject: Fwd: Quantitative Ecologist Position at CDFW
parts:
The California Department of Fish and Wildlife has a position that will be of interest to some on this list. Note the application deadline is this week.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Furnas, Brett@Wildlife <Brett....@wildlife.ca.gov>
Date: Fri, Jun 13, 2025 at 2:03 PM
Subject: Quantitative Ecologist Position at CDFW

Please feel free to distribute the following job advertisement for a Quantitative Ecologist at CDFW (closing date is 6/28):
https://calcareers.ca.gov/CalHrPublic/Jobs/JobPosting.aspx?JobControlId=479635

Ideally, we are looking for someone with post doc experience working with Bayesian models for SCR, distance sampling, IPMs, and other applied approaches to population estimation for large mammals using data from fDNA, cameras, aerial counts and FLIR, GPS telemetry, and harvest records (including age from teeth).

Best,

Brett Furnas, Ph.D.
Senior Environmental Scientist Supervisor
Big Game Conservation and Science Support Programs
Wildlife Branch, California Department of Fish and Wildlife
1010 Riverside Parkway, West Sacramento, CA 95605 USA
